info.name: Restaurant Reconciliation API
info.description: Ordered API checks for the close-then-adjust workflow. Run the collection in order: Reset → baseline reads → close → late settlement adjustments → immutability check. All money assertions use integer minor units.

request.description: Restores the deterministic baseline in the full Node reconciliation service.

exec: pm.test('fixture has no close or adjustment', () => { pm.expect(body.state.closes).to.be.an('array').that.is.empty; pm.expect(body.state.adjustments).to.be.an('array').that.is.empty; });
pm.test('health payload is OK', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.eql({ ok: true }));

pm.test('baseline financial totals are deterministic', () => { pm.expect(body.date).to.eql(pm.variables.replaceIn('{{businessDate}}')); pm.expect(body).to.include({ orders: 9, gross: 10200, platformDiscount: 300, commission: 720, paid: 8280, revenue: 7560 }); });

pm.test('baseline exceptions preserve operational evidence', () => { const reasons = body.exceptions.map((item) => item.reason); pm.expect(reasons).to.include.members(['COOKED_UNPAID', 'PAID_UNCOOKED', 'CANCELLED_AFTER_COOKING', 'AMBIGUOUS_DUPLICATE']); });

pm.test('baseline source evidence is retained', () => { pm.expect(body.orders).to.have.length(9); pm.expect(body.kitchens).to.have.length(8); pm.expect(body.settlements).to.be.an('array').that.is.empty; });
pm.test('close captures the baseline snapshot', () => pm.expect(close).to.include({ id: 'close_day_2026-08-10', revenue: 7560, gross: 10200, platformDiscount: 300, commission: 720, paid: 8280 }));
pm.test('repeat close returns the original immutable snapshot', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.deep.equal(original));

pm.test('two linked, signed ledger entries are created', () => { pm.expect(adjustments).to.have.length(2); pm.expect(adjustments.map((item) => item.amount)).to.have.members([50, -50]); adjustments.forEach((item) => pm.expect(item.closeId).to.eql('close_day_2026-08-10')); });

pm.test('settlement exceptions are visible', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const reasons = pm.response.json().map((item) => item.reason); pm.expect(reasons).to.include.members(['COMMISSION_MISMATCH', 'DISCOUNT_MISMATCH', 'UNMATCHED_SETTLEMENT', 'SETTLEMENT_TIMING']); });

item.name: 10 - Verify close snapshot was not changed

exec: pm.test('late settlement did not mutate the close', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json()[0]).to.deep.equal(original));
pm.test('unknown API route is rejected', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(404); pm.expect(pm.response.json().error).to.eql('not found'); });

item.name: 12 - Custom order simulation (run separately)
item.description: This folder resets the shared fixture and then runs a custom order through ingestion, kitchen confirmation, close, late settlement, and adjustment creation.

exec: pm.test('custom scenario starts from a clean baseline', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().ok).to.eql(true); });
pm.test('custom order is accepted once', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.deep.equal({ accepted: 1, ignored: 0 }); });
pm.test('identical order replay is a no-op', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.deep.equal({ accepted: 0, ignored: 1 }); });
pm.test('kitchen evidence is accepted', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.deep.equal({ accepted: 1, ignored: 0 }); });
pm.test('custom order contributes to the daily totals', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.include({ orders: 10, gross: 11450, paid: 9530, revenue: 8810 }); });
pm.test('custom close includes the simulated order', () => { pm.expect(close.revenue).to.eql(8810); pm.expect(close.orderIds).to.include('order_app_DEMO-001'); });
pm.test('late settlement is accepted', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.deep.equal({ accepted: 1, ignored: 0 }); });

pm.test('late settlement creates an adjustment', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const adjustments = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(adjustments).to.have.length(1); pm.expect(adjustments[0]).to.include({ orderId: 'order_app_DEMO-001', amount: -150, reason: 'SETTLEMENT_VARIANCE', component: 'discount' }); });

pm.test('late settlement did not mutate the custom close', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const original = JSON.parse(pm.collectionVariables.get('customCloseSnapshot')); pm.expect(pm.response.json()[0]).to.deep.equal(original); });
